_about: Settings for the simulated townspeople. 'default' applies to everyone; entries by character id (31 + c) change it for one person. pay: Simoleons per hour worked. rent: due every Monday at midnight. decay: how fast each need drops, in percent of normal (hunger, hygiene, energy, social, comfort, bladder, fun, room). Home and job are worked out from each person's own timetable (home = where they are at night, job = where they are on weekday working hours).
